title: Case law library in Parachute
summary: Search and read Australian judgments inside Parachute, and click any case it cites to open the judgment beside your thread.
body_markdown:
Parachute now has a case law library you can search and read without leaving the app.


## Search and read judgments


Open **Case law** under Legal sources to search judgments from the High Court, the Federal Court and the NSW courts, including recent decisions.


## Click a citation, read the judgment


When Parachute cites a case from the library, click the citation and the judgment opens beside your thread, at the passage it’s citing.


## Also in this release


- **Choose how each source is used.** Set legislation and case law to Off, Auto or Always, and web search to Off or Auto, for your workspace, a matter or a single thread. Answers show which sources were consulted.
- **Legislation, read in full.** Parachute already grounds answers in legislation. Now it reads the text of the Act itself while it researches.
- **Precedents from your documents.** When Parachute fills a precedent from documents you attach, it uses what’s in them. Where they’re silent, it leaves a placeholder and flags it rather than inventing facts.
